counting_rules.resolution_ladder_policy: Spatial ladders (dp0.006, dp0.005, dp0.0045) are discretization convergence studies and NEVER count as separate physical cases.
counting_rules.reruns_and_time_slices: Reruns, temporal slices, and derived viewing products do NOT increment the physical case count.
counting_rules.physical_uniqueness: Each independent physical case MUST possess distinct physical forcing parameter coordinates (transverse_amplitude_m_s2, pitch_amplitude_ratio).

canonical_mother_geometry.coordinate_frame: fixed tank coordinates with prescribed body acceleration (acctimesfile); walls are fixedType0 in accelerating frame

longitudinal_axis.mechanism: prescribed pitch rotation alpha_y(t) with coupled linear ax(t), az(t) via zero-drive scaling

transverse_axis.mechanism: bounded transverse linear acceleration a_y(t) exciting fundamental transverse eigenmode
transverse_axis.formula: a_y(t) = A_y * E(t) * sin(omega_y * t + phi_y)

envelope.type: Hann/cosine smooth startup and shutdown ramp E(t)
